title: UNDP-UNITAR framework — satellite imagery analysis 30% faster crisis response
snippet: UNDP and UNITAR announce a joint framework for satellite imagery analysis that achieves 30% faster crisis response times. The framework standardizes how satellite data from multiple providers is processed, analyzed, and disseminated to field teams during humanitarian emergencies. Integrates Sentinel-2, Planet, and Maxar imagery with AI-assisted damage assessment to accelerate post-disaster recovery planning. Piloted in recent disaster responses across South and Southeast Asia.
tag_reason: New humanitarian satellite analysis framework. Cross-cutting relevance to disaster response and crisis management domains.

entities.name: UNITAR (United Nations Institute for Training and Research)
